transition_messages.execute: PR split rule (decided 2026-11-10): keep in PR #1 (claude/home-assistant-integration-e7acd4) anything that does not change behaviour and stays inside files the four bug-fix commits already touch -- lint/docstring/typing cleanups, naming and comment fixes, dead-code removal, test hygiene, small contract/error-handling tightening (T1/T2). Defer to a follow-up PR any structural refactor: module splits or moves, new abstractions, API-surface or package reorganisation, dependency restructuring, anything that rewrites a file PR #1 does not touch (T3/T4). Record deferred items with 'desloppify plan skip' plus a note naming the follow-up PR.
